requiredBehavior: Move store persistence lifecycle policy and publication sequencing to MNCS using the current typed filesystem capabilities; retain host code only for external filesystem/process transport and explicit platform limitations.
summary: Profile 0.18 now provides bounded file mutation, rename, directory creation, listing, deletion, and sync primitives. The remaining pressure is consumer cutover: mncs-store still makes its persistence lifecycle and publication path ordinary Python execution.
title: mncs-store persistence lifecycle still uses host publication mechanics
